about_the_game:
Welcome to Void Authority – The Universe’s Most Dangerous Desk Job.

Check papers, scan contraband, and decide who gets to cross the stars in Void Authority, a roguelike document-inspection game where every decision shifts the fate of a galaxy on the brink.

You’re the lone inspector at a dusty border checkpoint orbiting a forgotten world. Aliens line up in their rickety ships, each with stories, secrets, and suspicious cargo. Will you uphold interstellar law, take a bribe, or let the rebels slip through to fuel a quiet revolution?

In Void Authority, you begin each run as a new inspector in a galaxy that remembers your choices. Different species, shifting political climates, and a mounting stack of paperwork challenge you as you upgrade your tools, unlock shortcuts, and make judgment calls that ripple across future inspections—all while you transfer between outposts, climbing to more critical positions as the galaxy edges toward crisis.

Key Features:

  • Interrogate and Inspect: Verify licenses, scan for contraband, and question travelers about their reasons for visiting.

  • Roguelike Progression: Each run changes the galaxy’s laws, factions, and your equipment, creating fresh challenges every session.

  • Hand-drawn Art Style: Colorful aliens and vibrant sci-fi contraptions bring your dusty space office to life

  • Political Consequences: Who you let through changes who holds power tomorrow.

  • Tools of the Trade: Use X-ray scanners, Seal Verifiers and other unique tools to correctly process intergalactic travelers 

  • A Dystopian Story with Humor: A darkly comedic look at bureaucracy, corruption, and what it means to do your job when the universe is falling apart.

You have a universe of paperwork to file, inspector. The line is waiting.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 or better)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
